title: Kraken staking services begin operating
description: Kraken developed exchange-linked staking services that allowed customers to earn rewards through a managed staking program.
notes: Launch year is approximate and should be refined with archived product pages.

title: SEC announces Kraken staking settlement
description: The SEC announced that Kraken agreed to cease offering staking-as-a-service to U.S. clients and pay $30 million in disgorgement, interest, and civil penalties.

title: U.S. Kraken staking service ends under settlement
description: Kraken ended the relevant U.S. staking-as-a-service program after the settlement, while non-U.S. staking availability and future product designs remained separate questions.
notes: U.S.-specific service end, not full Kraken platform end.

title: Kraken launches new staking product for eligible U.S. clients
description: Kraken announced a new staking product for eligible U.S. clients in selected states after the earlier settlement, creating a product-transition history rather than a simple permanent shutdown record.
notes: Treat as redesigned or relaunched staking availability, not the same as the settled 2023 product.
